states.name: duck-and-cover
states.description: DEFCON 3: Duck and Cover degrades it to 2 and the US receives 5-2 = 3 VP. US to act.

states.name: duck-and-cover-defcon-1-loses
states.description: DEFCON 2: Duck and Cover degrades it to 1 - nuclear war, so the US (who played it) loses the game, and the 4 VP it would have scored don't matter. US to act.

states.name: fidel
states.description: Cuba holds US 2 / USSR 1. Fidel removes all US influence and raises the USSR to stability (3) for Control. USSR to act.

states.name: fidel-ussr-already-above-stability
states.description: Cuba holds US 1 / USSR 5. Fidel removes the US influence and adds nothing, since the USSR is already past stability (3). USSR to act.

states.name: romanian-abdication
states.description: Romania holds US 2 / USSR 0. Removes all US influence, USSR raised to stability (3). USSR to act.

states.name: nasser-rounds-up
states.description: Egypt holds US 3 / USSR 0. Nasser adds 2 USSR, then the US removes half rounded up (2 of 3), leaving US 1 / USSR 2. USSR to act.

states.name: de-gaulle-leads-france
states.description: France holds US 3 / USSR 0: removes 2 US, adds 1 USSR, leaving US 1 / USSR 1. USSR to act.

states.name: nuclear-test-ban-us-defcon-4
states.description: DEFCON 4: the US receives 4-2 = 2 VP, then DEFCON improves by 2 but caps at 5. US to act.

states.name: nuclear-test-ban-ussr-defcon-3
states.description: DEFCON 3, VP 0: the USSR (playing it) receives 3-2 = 1 VP, so VP goes to -1, and DEFCON improves to 5. USSR to act.

states.name: kitchen-debates-us-ahead
states.description: The US controls France (battleground), the USSR controls none, so the US gets 2 VP. US to act.

states.name: kitchen-debates-tied
states.description: US and USSR each control one battleground: no VP. US to act.

states.name: portuguese-empire-crumbles
states.description: Empty board: adds 2 USSR to each of Angola and SE African States. USSR to act.

states.name: allende
states.description: Empty board: adds 2 USSR to Chile. USSR to act.

states.name: panama-canal-returned
states.description: Empty board: adds 1 US to each of Panama, Costa Rica and Venezuela. US to act.

states.name: camp-david-accords
states.description: Empty board: +1 VP to the US, and +1 US each in Israel, Jordan and Egypt. US to act.

states.name: john-paul-ii-elected-pope
states.description: Poland holds US 0 / USSR 3: removes 2 USSR, adds 1 US, leaving US 1 / USSR 1. US to act.

states.name: sadat-expels-soviets
states.description: Egypt holds US 1 / USSR 3: removes all USSR, adds 1 US, leaving US 2 / USSR 0. US to act.

states.name: alliance-for-progress
states.description: The US controls Panama and Cuba (Central America) and Chile (South America), all battlegrounds, plus non-battleground Costa Rica: +3 VP. US to act.

states.name: iranian-hostage-crisis
states.description: Iran holds US 3 / USSR 1: removes all US, adds 2 USSR, leaving US 0 / USSR 3. USSR to act.

states.name: the-iron-lady
states.description: UK holds USSR 2: removed. Argentina gets 1 USSR. The US receives 1 VP. US to act.

states.name: reagan-bombs-libya-odd
states.description: Libya holds USSR 3: 1 VP per 2 USSR influence rounds down to 1 VP for the US. US to act.

states.name: an-evil-empire
states.description: +1 VP to the US. US to act.

states.name: awacs-sale-to-saudis
states.description: Empty board: adds 2 US to Saudi Arabia. US to act.

states.name: vp-cap-us-wins
states.description: VP at +19: An Evil Empire's +1 VP reaches +20 and the US wins by VP. US to act.

states.name: opponents-event
states.description: USSR to act holding Kitchen Debates, a US card. The USSR may still play it as an event: the US gets its 2 VP regardless of who plays it.

states.name: arms-race-required-met
states.description: USSR has 4 Military Ops to the US's 2, DEFCON 4 (required 4): ahead and the required amount met, so Arms Race pays the USSR 3 VP. USSR to act.

states.name: arms-race-ahead-only
states.description: USSR has 3 Military Ops to the US's 1, DEFCON 5 (required 5): ahead but short of the required amount, so Arms Race pays 1 VP. USSR to act.

states.name: arms-race-not-ahead
states.description: Both sides at 3 Military Ops: a tie isn't 'higher', so Arms Race pays nothing. USSR to act.

states.name: u2-incident
states.description: U2 Incident pays the USSR 1 VP. USSR to act.

states.name: opec
states.description: USSR controls Egypt, Iran and Venezuela; Libya is only contested (US 2 / USSR 2) and Saudi Arabia is US-controlled. OPEC pays 3 VP. USSR to act.

states.name: defectors-played-by-ussr
states.description: USSR holds Defectors, a US card, and plays it in its action round: the US gets 1 VP. USSR to act.

states.name: defectors-played-by-us
states.description: The US plays Defectors in its own action round: with no USSR headline to cancel, nothing happens. US to act.

states.name: abm-treaty
states.description: DEFCON 3, USSR to act holding ABM Treaty (4 ops). The event improves DEFCON to 4, then the USSR may use the card's 4 ops for any operation (or pass to skip them). Poland holds USSR 1.

states.name: kal-007-south-korea-us-controlled
states.description: US to act holding KAL-007 at DEFCON 4. South Korea is US-controlled (US 4), so after DEFCON drops to 3 and the US gets 2 VP it may place influence or realign (not coup) with the card's 4 ops.

states.name: kal-007-south-korea-not-controlled
states.description: US to act holding KAL-007 at DEFCON 4, but South Korea is only contested (US 1 / USSR 1): DEFCON drops and the US gets 2 VP, but no operation follows.

states.name: kal-007-played-by-ussr
states.description: USSR to act holding the US card KAL-007, with South Korea US-controlled: the USSR playing it still hands the US 2 VP and drops DEFCON, but only the US gets the operation, so none follows.

states.name: glasnost-reformer-played
states.description: USSR to act holding Glasnost at DEFCON 3, with The Reformer already played: DEFCON improves, the USSR gets 2 VP, and it may then place influence or realign (not coup) with the card's 4 ops. Poland holds USSR 1.

states.name: glasnost-reformer-not-played
states.description: USSR to act holding Glasnost at DEFCON 3 with The Reformer not yet played: DEFCON improves and the USSR gets 2 VP, but no operation follows.

states.name: cia-created
states.description: US to act holding CIA Created; the USSR holds Fidel and Nasser. The event reveals the USSR hand, then the US may use the card's 1 op for any operation. Japan holds US 1.

states.name: lone-gunman
states.description: USSR to act holding Lone Gunman; the US holds NATO and Containment. The event reveals the US hand, then the USSR may use the card's 1 op for any operation. Poland holds USSR 1.
